plugins.name: usage-band
plugins.description: Band above the prompt with an animated mascot that suggests the next step: context ring, prompt-cache thermometer with cold alerts and optional keep-warm, plan limits with pace bars and weekly day tiles, or API spend gauge vs budget, plus token split and warnings.

plugins.name: github-pane
plugins.description: Live GitHub pane for the current repo: PRs with CI and review state, workflow runs, issues and what needs you.

plugins.name: test-pane
plugins.description: Live pane of the test runs Claude makes through Bash: pass/fail per test, flaky tests flagged, rerun only the failed ones, and a Fix with Claude prompt draft.

plugins.name: theme-builder
plugins.description: A skill that builds your own theme mod for the Claude desktop and mobile apps: light and dark palettes from a mood or colors, contrast checked until Desktop paints it, with an optional backdrop, message style and sound.
